reasoning_content:
Links are JS chunks; content is client-rendered. Let me just probe likely routes: /access, /keys, /console, /dashboard, /auth, /login, /start.

Better: use the docs text — "Get an API key" link. Let me fetch docs HTML and search for "api" routes via regex on full HTML (maybe href="/access").

Let me grep for routes not starting with /_next.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://lebrel.ai/docs" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' | grep -v "_next" | sort -u | head -30; echo "=== coba route umum ==="; for p in /access /keys /console /login /start /api-keys /models /status; do printf "%-12s " "$p"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 12 -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://lebrel.ai$p"; done
